help.title: Help
help.start.title: Starting a focus session
help.start.body: Press Start focus. Pause, resume, end the session, or discard it from the main window. Ending a focus session does not count toward a long break.
help.breaks.title: Breaks and long breaks
help.breaks.body: After focus ends, the break starts automatically unless you turned that off. A long break follows every few rounds. Postponing moves the break five minutes later; skipping discards it.
help.countdown.title: Independent countdown
help.countdown.body: When the focus timer is idle, start a countdown from the main window. It runs on its own, is saved in history, and never changes your focus rounds.
help.overlay.title: Floating ball
help.overlay.body: The floating ball stays on top and shows the remaining time. Choose Locate floating ball in Settings or the tray menu to find it, or drag it to move it.
help.history.title: History and data
help.history.body: Every session is stored locally by date, including countdowns. Open History to review individual sessions or export a Excel copy. The app does not send data anywhere.
help.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.shortcuts.body: Start or pause focus, end the current phase, and show or hide the countdown from anywhere using the global shortcuts.
help.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
help.troubleshooting.body: Countdowns run on their own and never change your focus rounds. If reminders stay silent, check the reminder settings and the system audio output. The app works offline.
